| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Taps** `taps` | 15 | 3 to 63, odd | Number of 1D weights N. The window is N by N pixels. |
| **Cutoff** `cutoff` | 0.15 | 0.01 to 0.5 cycles/px | Frequency where the filter changes from keeping to removing. 0.5 is the finest pattern, one cycle per two pixels. |
| **Window** `window` | Hamming | Hamming, Hann, Blackman, Kaiser | The taper applied to the ideal sinc taps. |
| **Kaiser beta** `beta` | 5 | 0 to 14 | Shape of the Kaiser window. Used only with the Kaiser window. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
| **Linear light** `linearLight` | off | On or off | Filter linear light values instead of sRGB encoded values. |
